description_en: Retrieves the details of a user group in a bastion host
description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机用户组的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host in which you want to query the details of the user group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询用户组详情的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host in which you want to query the details of the user group.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询用户组详情的堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query the ID of the user group
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

UserGroup.description_en: The details of the user group returned
UserGroup.description_zh: 查询到的用户组详细信息

Comment.description_en: The description of the user group

UserGroupName.description_en: The name of the user group
